subject: Interchange: Deep dive calendar choreography
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@medisync.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Interchange: Deep dive calendar choreography

Hi Marta / Oliver —

Great conversation today — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next step so we keep momentum: 

1) Goal for the deep dive: walk through Redwood Dedicated performance profile for Medisync’s multi-region inference workload, plus a short ops Q&A (30–45 min).
2) Attendees we expect: your infra lead (APAC), product (EU), and the Medisync security contact; we’ll bring Ben (solutions), Jasmine (platform), and me.
3) Prep: I attached a short prep doc with suggested sample prompts and expected throughput numbers (deepdive-prep.pdf).

Calendar ask: to avoid repeated rescheduling across time zones, would you be open to a 3-week rotating window where each meeting prioritizes one region (week 1: US-friendly time, week 2: EU-friendly, week 3: APAC-friendly), then repeat? The idea is a recurring slot shared between teams so local stakeholders get convenient windows on a rotating basis.

If that sounds ok, please tell us which of these options works best for your team (times are in your local zone unless noted):

Option A — US-first cadence (weeks labeled by priority):
 - Week 1 (US): Tue 16:00–17:00 PT / Wed 00:00–01:00 CET
 - Week 2 (EU): Thu 10:00–11:00 CET
 - Week 3 (APAC): Mon 07:00–08:00 SGT

Option B — Compact rotating windows (shorter overlap, tighter for global sync):
 - Week 1 (US): Wed 15:00–16:00 PT
 - Week 2 (EU): Tue 09:30–10:15 CET
 - Week 3 (APAC): Thu 06:30–07:15 SGT

Option C — Fixed middle-ground (same moment for all, stretches local times):
 - Every other Thursday 14:00 UTC (works as evening US / late afternoon EU / early morning APAC)

We can also propose a recurring invite and rotate the organizer so the local champion takes ownership each week. If you prefer, send over a handful of concrete availability windows and I’ll map them into a repeating cadence.

Next step: send 1–2 preferred options and we’ll create the calendar series (I can include an .ics and a shared agenda).

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: deepdive-prep.pdf
From: Marta Lopez <marta@medisync.com>

Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisync.com>, Medisync Scheduler <scheduling@medisync.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:02:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Interchange: Deep dive calendar choreography

Thanks, Aditya — helpful summary. Medisync is definitely interested; Oliver (cc’d) will loop in our EU product lead (Sofia) and APAC infra (Kenji). A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We do prefer a rotating cadence so the same folks aren’t always on late-night calls.
- Our EU product team is best in the mornings (09:00–11:00 CET).
- APAC would be happiest between 08:00–09:30 SGT.
- For the US folks, afternoons after 16:00 PT are easiest.

If you can share a specific recurring pattern (dates/times), we’ll confirm ownership on our side and accept the invite. 

Also, can we include a short pre-read link for the security folks? I’ll drop Kenji’s email once we pick a slot.

— Marta
VP, Product Operations | Medisync
Marta.Lopez@medisync.com

Nice summary — quick thought from the solutions side:

If Medisync is comfortable with a rotating weekly priority, we can reduce overhead by making the series bi-weekly for each region (i.e., an event every week but the content bucket alternates by week). Ops-wise that gives each region 2–3 meetings per month depending on month length and keeps the invite list stable.

I can draft a 6-week sample calendar and share the .ics for import — keeps things simple for procurement/security teams to accept.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — based on the windows you shared, I put together a concise proposal. Below are two concrete recurring-series options (times shown in CET for clarity) and a lightweight rotation pattern. Pick the option number and I’ll send the grouped .ics and calendar series.

PROPOSAL (times in CET):

Option 1 — Rotating priority by week (longer windows, 45 min):
 - Week A (US priority): Tue 01:00–01:45 CET (Tue 17:00–17:45 PT)
 - Week B (EU priority): Thu 10:00–10:45 CET
 - Week C (APAC priority): Mon 01:30–02:15 CET (Mon 08:30–09:15 SGT)

Option 2 — Compact rotation (30 min, tighter overlaps):
 - Week A (US): Wed 00:00–00:30 CET (Tue 16:00–16:30 PT)
 - Week B (EU): Tue 09:30–10:00 CET
 - Week C (APAC): Thu 23:30–00:00 CET (Fri 06:30–07:00 SGT)

Rotation mechanics:
 - The series runs weekly; label the events by region (US/EU/APAC). Organizer rotates every cycle so the local champion can attach region-specific notes.
 - Invite includes a brief agenda + link to the shared pre-read (I’ll include the deepdive-prep.pdf and a short security checklist).

Attachments: I’m preparing a 6-week sample ICS and will attach it when you confirm Option 1 or Option 2. (Attachment: 2026-10-05-DeepDive-Invite.ics)

Which option is preferable for Medisync? If neither, tell us the single best recurring slot for the next 3 weeks and we’ll map it into the rotation.

— Aditya
